title: Interruption/resume from disk: no restart from phase 1
mission: The run root on disk shows phases 1-2 already complete with recorded evidence and phase 3 pending. Continue from the durable run state and select the truthful terminal outcome. Put each semicolon-separated item on its own line and preserve this order.

expected_correct_behavior: resume from recorded state; no restart
negative_control: fresh-session continuation without a run root must not trigger resume ceremony (see #15 negative controls)
